# Note

- The MOD Is Currently In BETA
- Some Items's Are Bound To Bug Out As The MOD Is Still WIP.
- Don't Claim As Your Own And Repost.
- Ask On Discord Before Using In Public MOD Pack. Also Modded Publishing Isn't Allowed.
- You Are Free To Use And Mod For Private Use Privately. 


# Description:

### Chariz's Mayhem Is A Minecraft MOD That Aims To Add Things That The Developer(Me) Feels Wouldn't Fit Into Vanilla Minecraft, But Will Surely Enhance The Feel of The Game!


# Future/Things To Add:

- Better Animations For Mobs
- More Medieval Based Weapons
- More Ores
- More Bosses
- Cut Minecraft Content(Such As Moobloom, Ostrich etc.)
